capabilities: Render a monthly calendar from one Markdown file per month
Open a date's section in the native Markdown editor on click
Create missing month files or date sections without overwriting content
Navigate between months with previous, next, picker, and current-month controls
Show format hints for duplicate or invalid date headings
extras: Still undergoing automated review and not yet listed in the in-app directory. Interface labels are currently Chinese only, and mobile layouts were checked only at narrow desktop viewports, not on physical iOS or Android devices.
intentEvidence: 点击进入原生笔记，替代网站的详情弹窗
problem: Obsidian has no built-in monthly calendar, and date-based workflows usually mean one file per day instead of one file per month.

relations.evidence: 沿用桌面双栏拆分、28px 栏间距、窄日期栏、48px 最小行高和今天底色

summary: Offline monthly calendar view where each month is one local Markdown file and each date links into Obsidian's native editor.
